newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma pierces 312,bonds, depos, forwards hold.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma pierces 312,bonds, depos, forwards hold.

text.p: The drachma fell to all-time low of 312 against the ecu in early trade and dealers said a central bank intervention would be needed to prevent it from sliding further.
They said depos were steady but for a minor drop in longer maturities, forwards were stable and bonds were holding.
